snippet.title: Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen | Console & PC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Gold Pen is missing… and a brand-new adventure begins.

The heartfelt adventure game inspired by the Emmy® and BAFTA Award-winning series Bluey arrives on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox series X, Xbox series S, PC via Steam, PC via Epic Store - May 28, 2026.

Join everyone’s favorite Blue Heeler in Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen, a story-driven journey filled with laughter, heart, and discovery.

When Dad snatches the Gold Pen Bluey needs to finish her drawing, Bluey and her family are swept into a playful new world brought to life by imagination. Explore charming, hand-drawn environments, uncover hidden treasures, and solve light puzzles as you help bring the Gold Pen home.

Written by Bluey creator Joe Brumm, this original story features fully animated cutscenes and exploration-focused gameplay designed to be enjoyed by fans and families alike.
